faults.what: "Seventy-two percent" is spoken 22.22 to 23.18 s but the display and receipt still show -- until about 23.5 s, 1.3 s after the number starts and after it ends. Fix: time the 72% ring to the word Seventy-two (scene.js line 161, tInf from the why cue /^Seventy-two/), not /^inflation/.

The falling coins cross the PAY display and sit on the digits of +3.7% (e.g. a coin on the 3 at 31.8 s, coins on the screen at 30.9 and 31.2 s) while three point seven is said. Fix: draw the display above the coin layer, or keep the coin paths out of x 665 to 985, y 340 to 540.

The register display figure is right aligned past the safe edge: the % ends at x 944 and the blinking cursor at x 959, beyond x 930. Fix: move the display (or its right text anchor) about 30 px left so the figure and cursor end at x 925 or less.
